summary.text: alpha-project is the local-first notes app [[owner-example]] has built since June 2025, with [[bob-example]] designing its editor; it launched publicly on the App Store in September 2026, priced at 25 euros paid once.

paragraphs.text: alpha-project keeps every note as a plain markdown file and is written in Swift. Notes link to one another with wikilinks in an editor [[bob-example]] designed, and search runs on a local full-text index that answers in under 20 ms on 5,000 notes.

Notes sync between devices through a [[SQLite]] database, and a sync conflict keeps both copies. Since April 2026 synced notes are encrypted end to end with a key that never leaves the device, which beta testers had asked for in March 2026.

owner-example started alpha-project in June 2025 as a weekend experiment, and in July 2025 sync between a laptop and a phone first worked. bob-example joined in August 2025 to design the editor; in September 2025 search moved to a local full-text index, and in November 2025 the first iOS build, made with SwiftUI and sharing its sync code with the Mac app, ran on a phone.
In December 2025 sync failed on vaults over 10,000 notes because of a lock timeout; batching writes fixed it in January 2026.
The private beta opened in February 2026 with 40 testers and had grown to 320 by August 2026. The public launch on the App Store, planned since July 2026, came on 20 September 2026.
In October 2025 owner-example was considering charging a one-time price of 30 euros for alpha-project. In May 2026 owner-example decided on a one-time price: alpha-project costs 25 euros, paid once.
As of September 2026, alpha-project is on the App Store at 25 euros, paid once, with end-to-end encrypted sync.

summary.text: bob-example is an interface designer and a former colleague of [[owner-example]] who has designed the editor of [[alpha-project]] since August 2025.

paragraphs.text: bob-example is an interface designer who works from Lisbon. bob-example and owner-example worked together at a previous job.
Since August 2025 bob-example has designed the editor of [[alpha-project]], and in January 2026 bob-example reviewed alpha-project's onboarding screens.

In October 2025 bob-example argued against a subscription for alpha-project and suggested a one-time price. In May 2026 bob-example agreed with the one-time price and will receive a share of alpha-project's sales for the design work.
